user_query: I'm working on a personal project that involves analyzing text data. I need a tool that can check if a given text contains profane language. Can you recommend an API that provides this functionality? Additionally, it would be helpful if the API offers advanced features for content validation and supports multiple languages.

TaskList.description: Identify a suitable API that checks for profane language in text, with support for multiple languages.
Evaluate the advanced features offered by the identified API for content validation.
Integrate the chosen API into the project for real-time text analysis.
Test the integration with various text inputs to ensure the profane language detection works as expected.
